messages:
rachel: CI perf alert: main -> chat-smallseq p50 jumped ~25% after last deps merge :facepalm:
infra-bot: perf-suite failure detected: job perf/chat-smallseq — baseline 18ms -> 23ms (2026-03-18T15:04Z) https://perf.redwood/ratchet/1234 :warning:
ajay: saw the alert, thanks. can someone bisect the merge range? my hunch is a lib bump (triton/torch)
marten: quick triage — I grabbed a flamegraph, looks like attention kernel changed from fused->split path. flame: https://perf.redwood/flame/5678 :eyes:
olivia: interesting — fused_attention is the low-latency path for small batches. if kernel selector prefers split variants we blow p50. any recent triton autotune/table changes?
ajay: deps PR included triton 2.1.3 and nvrtc cache tweak (commit abc123). running local repro now with triton==2.1.3 + torch==2.4.1+cu12.5
rachel: repro on A10 VM: baseline image (triton 2.1.1) p50=19ms, new image p50=24ms. reproduces reliably for seq=128 batch=2 chat pattern.
marten: ran perf with kernel tracing enabled. selector picks "matmul_split_stride" + separate softmax in new build vs "fused_attention_fastpath" before. KV cache path identical, so this is purely kernel choice.
ajay: bisect results: the triton bump from 2.1.1 -> 2.1.3 flips autotune table ordering for matmul heuristics. confirmed via `triton.autotune.table` diff. culprit commit: triton#872: reorder tile candidates for sm_86.
olivia: can we hotfix by forcing a kernel hint for the fused path while we decide to pin/revert? runtime supports a per-model kernel_hint config.
rachel: +1 to hotfix, want minimal change to preserve rollout. proposed config snippet:

```
model_config:
  name: chat_v2
  kernel_hint: fused_attention_fastpath
```

ajay: patch looks fine. also opened an infra ticket to pin triton to 2.1.1 in CI matrix: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3210
ci-bot: scheduled perf re-run for PR #4589 (hotfix config) — results will post in ~15m
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued to dedicated pool (canary-size=3) once CI green
marten: quick note — kernel_hint is a brittle escape hatch. we should also add a unit test that checks kernel selection for small-batch chat in our perf smoke harness. I'll open a follow-up.
rachel: CI results: p50 19.5ms (within noise vs baseline). perf suite green for chat-smallseq. https://perf.redwood/runs/7890 :thumbsup:
ajay: great. next steps: pin triton in CI, revert autotune reorder in our triton fork or upstream PR, and add selector regression test. marking as rollout-blocker until we pin.
olivia: filing a rollback/revert plan and a release note. FYI assigned to @marten and @ajay.
infra-bot: ticket INF-3210 updated: triton pinned to 2.1.1 in CI matrix, hotfix merged to canary branch, rollout blocked until revert plan complete.
rachel: thanks all. nice quick bisect. closing thread when INF-3210 shows resolved. :slightly_smiling_face:
